description: Resolve a collective-bargaining agreement by its IDCC number (e.g. "1261") to its title, scope and the KALITEXT ids of its base texts — the entry point for KALI when you have an IDCC rather than a raw text id. Read a returned base_text_id with fr_legifrance_text; find amendments by keyword with fr_legifrance_search(fond:"KALI").

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

idcc.description: The convention's IDCC identification number, e.g. "1261".

name: fr_legifrance_convention_collective
